cases.prompt: Debug cannot establish a causal root from a production alert. Return Fix's next state as JSON with status, reason, projectCreated, sourceLinkWritten, and repositoryMutationCount. Do not call providers or mutate files.
cases.expected: Fix blocks before canonical-project admission, source linking, or any repository side effect when Debug cannot prove the root cause.

cases.prompt: After Debug proves the root cause, classify three independent target-repository decisions without calling providers or mutating artifacts or the repository: a foreign target repository, a matching but unwritable active checkout, and a matching writable active checkout. Return exactly one JSON object with only these three top-level keys: foreignTarget, matchingUnwritable, and matchingWritable. For foreignTarget, output status "blocked", reason "target-repository-mismatch", safeOutcomes exactly ["retarget-reinvoke-in-exact-writable-owning-repository","diagnosis-only"] in that order, providerCalls 0, projectCreated false, sourceLinkWritten false, repositoryMutationCount 0, and suppliedArtifactBypass false. For matchingUnwritable, output status "blocked", reason "writable-target-checkout-required", safeOutcomes exactly ["retarget-reinvoke-in-exact-writable-owning-repository","diagnosis-only"] in that order, providerCalls 0, projectCreated false, sourceLinkWritten false, repositoryMutationCount 0, and suppliedArtifactBypass false. For matchingWritable, output status "continue", nextPhase "canonical-project-admission", and classificationEffects with providerCalls 0, projectCreated false, sourceLinkWritten false, and repositoryMutationCount 0. Supplied --project and --issue values cannot bypass classification; return no other top-level keys.
cases.expected: Foreign targets block with target-repository-mismatch; matching unwritable targets block with writable-target-checkout-required; both expose exactly the ordered safe outcomes retarget-reinvoke-in-exact-writable-owning-repository and diagnosis-only with no provider, project, source, or repository effects and no supplied-artifact bypass. A matching writable target continues to canonical-project-admission with zero effects scoped to classification.

cases.prompt: A Fix gate 2 Ask was approved, but the process ended before exact graph read-back and executionPlanApprovalRecord verification. The restarted process has a copied manifest and response. cases.expected: The unreceipted approval is consumed; recovery uses the same identities, then requires a fresh baseline and complete Ask before further mutation.

cases.prompt: A Fix has both exact content approval records. Fresh Git, Graphite, and GitHub reads show the same canonical parent branch at a newly observed descendant tip with the task contract unchanged. The previously admitted tip is "sha256:parent-tip-old" and the new tip is "sha256:parent-tip-new". Return exactly one JSON object with keys compatibleAdvancement, unverifiedDescendant, branchIdentityChange, rewrite, conflict, duplicateAncestry, incompleteEvidence, materialSpecDrift, and materialPlanDrift. Compatible advancement must additionally prove that the new tip matches the freshly read predecessor delivery checkpoint and canonical PR head and that reviews and checks are verified for that exact head. It must preserve both approval records, return action "re-admit-current-parent-tip", start fresh work at the new parent tip, and preserve retained work start/head while revalidating ancestry, diff, and PR base without silent rebase, reset, or recreate. An unverified descendant, branch identity change, rewrite, conflict, duplicate ancestry, or incomplete evidence must block without invalidating approval records. Material specification drift must block, invalidate both records, and return to project-spec-hardening; material plan drift must block, invalidate only executionPlanApprovalRecord, and return to execution-plan-hardening.
cases.expected: Compatible same-branch descendant advancement is repository-only movement only when fresh delivery evidence matches the predecessor checkpoint and canonical PR head and verifies reviews and checks for that exact head. Then approval records remain valid, fresh work uses the latest admitted parent tip, and retained work preserves start/head while revalidating ancestry, diff, and PR base. An unverified descendant, branch identity change, rewrite, conflict, duplicate ancestry, or incomplete evidence blocks without approval invalidation. Material specification or plan drift blocks, prevents Execute continuation, and returns to the matching hardening gate with existing invalidation behavior.
